surfaces.realization: PostgreSQL aios_personal_memory.personal_memory and the in-memory Store memories collection.
surfaces.deletionExpectation: One terminal tombstone remains for history, while live-state and plaintext hit counts are zero.

surfaces.realization: PostgreSQL B-tree personal_memory_recall_idx and Store listRecallMetadata/readRecallContent.
surfaces.deletionExpectation: A deleted Memory ID produces zero recall hits.

surfaces.realization: PostgreSQL conversation_checkpoint.memory_ids and Store checkpoint memoryIds.
surfaces.deletionExpectation: Every Checkpoint removes the deleted Memory ID in the deletion transaction.

surfaces.realization: Append-only memory_event records contain content_sha256 but no content column.
surfaces.deletionExpectation: Events retain hashes and state transitions, with zero plaintext-canary hits.

surfaces.realization: Append-only command_receipt stores operation results without personal-memory content.
surfaces.deletionExpectation: Receipts retain identifiers and results, with zero plaintext-canary hits.
Exported and newly hydrated snapshots have zero plaintext, recall, or Checkpoint-reference hits.

surfaces.realization: pg_dump output restored into a newly initialized PostgreSQL cluster with a distinct system identifier.
surfaces.deletionExpectation: The fresh-restored copy has zero live, plaintext, recall, and Checkpoint-reference hits for the probe.

surfaces.realization: No C09 vector or embedding relation, column, index, adapter, or API exists in P1.
surfaces.deletionExpectation: Runtime vector/embedding object count is zero; no propagation adapter is claimed.

surfaces.realization: No C09 personal-memory cache relation, adapter, or API exists in P1.
surfaces.deletionExpectation: Runtime personal-memory cache object count is zero; no propagation adapter is claimed.

supportSurfaces.reason: Owner and pause state only; no Memory ID or content column.
Principal-scope signing material only; no Memory ID or content column.

limitations: The terminal tombstone deliberately retains the Memory ID, state, content hash, and audit metadata; zero hit does not mean physical row removal.
Vector embeddings and a personal-memory cache are not implemented in P1, so this evidence proves absence rather than deletion propagation through those future adapters.
Production retention exceptions, legal holds, and backup-expiry policy are outside C09-AC06 and remain C09-AC07 scope.
This catalog and its tests do not modify D1, Gate decisions, the Manifest, or historical frozen evidence.
